data.name: content_search

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_search" USING fts5(entity_id UNINDEXED, type UNINDEXED, pack_id UNINDEXED, name, description, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_pack" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "namespace" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NOT NULL, "licence" TEXT NOT NULL, "attribution" TEXT NULL, "dsl_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_count" INTEGER NULL, "checksum" TEXT NULL, "signature" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pack_dependency" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "depends_on_pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_range" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id", "depends_on_pack_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ability" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "skill" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "ability_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "language" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "condition" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "damage_type" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mastery_property" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weapon" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "damage" TEXT NOT NULL, "damage_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "properties" TEXT NOT NULL, "versatile_damage" TEXT NULL, "range_normal_feet" INTEGER NULL, "range_long_feet" INTEGER NULL, "mastery_property_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "cost_cp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "armor" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_ac" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dex_cap" INTEGER NULL, "str_requirement" INTEGER NULL, "stealth_disadvantage" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("stealth_disadvantage" IN (0, 1)), "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "cost_cp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tool" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "ability_id" TEXT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "cost_cp" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "cost_cp" INTEGER NULL, "rarity" TEXT NULL, "attunement" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("attunement" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "origin_feat_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_feat_choices" TEXT NULL, "tool_choice_category" TEXT NULL, "gold_a" INTEGER NOT NULL, "equipment_gold_alt" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_ability" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "background_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ability_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("background_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_proficiency" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "background_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("background_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "background_equipment_option" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "background_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "option" TEXT NOT NULL, "items" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("background_id", "option"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feat" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "prerequisites" TEXT NULL, "repeatable" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("repeatable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "creature_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sizes" TEXT NOT NULL, "speed_feet" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species_trait" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "species_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "feature_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("species_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_class" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "hit_die" INTEGER NOT NULL, "primary_abilities" TEXT NOT NULL, "saving_throws" TEXT NOT NULL, "skill_choice_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skill_choices" TEXT NOT NULL, "weapon_proficiencies" TEXT NOT NULL, "armor_training" TEXT NOT NULL, "subclass_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "spellcasting_ability_id" TEXT NULL, "tool_proficiencies" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "tool_choice_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tool_choice_category" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "class_level" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "class_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "prof_bonus" INTEGER NOT NULL, "features" TEXT NOT NULL, "columns" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("class_id", "level"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subclass" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "parent_class_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subclass_feature" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "subclass_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "feature_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("subclass_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feature" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spell" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "school" TEXT NOT NULL, "casting_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "range" TEXT NOT NULL, "components" TEXT NOT NULL, "material_cost_cp" INTEGER NULL, "material_consumed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("material_consumed" IN (0, 1)), "duration" TEXT NOT NULL, "concentration" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("concentration" IN (0, 1)), "ritual" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("ritual" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spell_class" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "spell_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "class_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("spell_id", "class_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "monster" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "extends_id" TEXT NULL, "creature_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "challenge_rating" TEXT NOT NULL, "xp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "intelligence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stat_block" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "monster_action" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "monster_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "recharge" TEXT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("monster_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_reveal" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "monster_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reveal_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("monster_id", "dc"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "effect" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entity_text" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES content_pack (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_id", "locale"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pseudonym" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar" TEXT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fr', "settings" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_table" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "gm_user_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "stat_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "long_rest_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "hp_on_level_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "starting_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "progression_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_sheets_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("full_sheets_visible" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_member" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("table_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_invite" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revoked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("revoked" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_pack" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pinned_version" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("table_id", "pack_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "table_banned_entity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("table_id", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "player" TEXT NULL, "species_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "species_choices" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "background_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "xp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "level_unlock" TEXT NULL, "score_rolls" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_base_scores" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ability_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("character_id", "ability_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_background_choice" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "distribution" TEXT NOT NULL, "bonuses" TEXT NOT NULL, "feat_choices" TEXT NULL, "tool_choice" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("character_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_class_level" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "class_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subclass_id" TEXT NULL, "hp_roll" TEXT NULL, "skill_choices" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "expertise" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("character_id", "class_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_feat" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "feat_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "choices" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_weapon_mastery" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "weapon_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_spell" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "spell_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "prepared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("prepared" IN (0, 1)), "in_spellbook" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_spellbook" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_item" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "equipped" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("equipped" IN (0, 1)), "attuned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("attuned" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "hp_current" INTEGER NULL, "hp_temp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hit_dice_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "death_saves" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "exhaustion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "heroic_inspiration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("heroic_inspiration" IN (0, 1)), "resources" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "concentration_spell_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("character_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_content_ref" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_change_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "author_user_id" TEXT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "diff" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_language" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "language_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "character_choice" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "character_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES character (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "choice_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "selections" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("character_id", "choice_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "npc_statblock" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "monster_id" TEXT NULL, "stat_block" TEXT NULL, "attitude" TEXT NULL, "hidden_info" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "encounter" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "difficulty" TEXT NULL, "hp_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "combatant" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "encounter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES encounter (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "initiative" INTEGER NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, "hp" INTEGER NULL, "ac" INTEGER NULL, "attitude" TEXT NULL, "visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("visible" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "encounter_event" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "encounter_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES encounter (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "round" INTEGER NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES game_table (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "private" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("private" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "author_identity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
